% SCI-FRUIT-NORMATIVE-CORE v0.1/r0.2: canonical notation and type authority.
\newcommand{\ca}{\mathrm{candidate}}\newcommand{\ac}{\mathrm{accepted}}\newcommand{\ap}{\mathrm{applied}}
\newcommand{\yin}{y_k^{\mathrm{in}}}\newcommand{\ma}{m_k^{\ap}}
\newcommand{\Op}{\Omega_{k,\mathrm{pre}(\mathcal L)}^{\mathrm{FRUIT}}}
\newcommand{\NA}{\texttt{unavailable\_pending\_separate\_owner\_approval}}
\newcommand{\CID}{SCI-FRUIT-NORMATIVE-CORE v0.1/r0.2}
\newcommand{\NormNotation}{\Unit{Authority, scientific objects and compatible arithmetic}{core:types}{%
\textbf{Program adherence and prior-work recovery.} This is the sole normative
scientific source for the targeted r0.2 revision. The r0.1 architecture was accepted as the revision basis; its artifacts are
historical input and comparison evidence. This r0.2 core is the complete sole
active Stage B scientific authority as an owner-review candidate and supersedes
r0.1. Every surviving obligation is stated here; no unstated r0.1 sentence
remains active. Exact Stage A sources and both r0.2 owner directives bind
provenance and scoped corrections; no broad derivation or Stage A reopening
occurs. Active authority as a review candidate is not owner freeze or numerical approval.
\textbf{A} (program order, decision 2026-09-06) authorizes conditional authorship;
\textbf{B} (conditional composition, decision 2026-09-06) authorizes conditional
remove/process/rejoin consequences. \textbf{C}, FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD v0.1, is a
required-record family, not an approved numerical instance. A/B do not imply C.
Every numerical route remains \NA. Stage A is frozen; Stage B is an owner-review
draft. Exact decisions and preserved bytes are in the authority packet.

Each scientific object binds quantity, unit/numerical scale, frame/domain,
grid/sampling, shape/axes/indexing, timing where relevant, grouping, support,
validity and missing/non-finite causes, producer/parent and generations.
Shape, time, filename or a shared label does not establish identity. Bind separately
\[
m_k^{\ca}\in M_k^{\ca},\quad m_k^{\ac}\in M_k^{\ac},\quad
\ma\in M_k=M_k^{\ap},\quad \yin\in Y_k,\quad z_k\in Z_k.
\]
Candidate is the proposed object; accepted is selected for feedback; applied
is the exact removal/rejoin operand. Every transformation among their spaces
and objects is explicit, including normalization, clipping, sign conversion,
support restriction, projection and unit conversion. Equality needs an exact
method/state fact: no equal domain, support, unit, normalization, sign,
representation, response, uncertainty or parentage is assumed. External models
retain parent/prior; learned models retain causal learning population,
selection, response, uncertainty and generations. Acceptance confers only
\texttt{feedback\_model\_state}, not truth, a detection, posterior, unbiased
sky/source estimate, catalogue, Pointing or OOF result.

$Y_k,Z_k$ shall be exact additive quantity spaces, or explicit affine/quotient
spaces with one declared reference/gauge for each operation and well-defined
additive-coordinate or quotient arithmetic. Arbitrary representative arithmetic
is forbidden. Removal and rejoin \emph{separately} require compatible quantity,
unit/scale, frame/domain, grid/sampling, support, additive origin/reference or
gauge, null-space state, calibration and response conventions. Every conversion
and alignment is declared. Pairwise compatibility does not imply $Y_k=Z_k$.
Missing compatibility makes the affected arithmetic and dependent claim unavailable.

Use $\rho_k$ for residual, $F_k$ for the complete residual procedure and $S_k$
for state. New FRUIT notation does not borrow generic $x/r$, bare $Q_p,N_p,C_p$
or unqualified NOI member/sign symbols. KID $x/r$ retain their paired-readout
meaning. The frozen PTC quotation has its own covered local symbols.
}}
